text: {"562":{"about":["rustc_expand"],"refers":[],"why":"Procedural-macro expansion is implemented by rustc_expand during the parsing/expansion process."},"563":{"about":["rustc_expand"],"refers":[],"why":"rustc_expand implements the compiler-side facility for executing externally implemented procedural macros."},"564":{"about":["rustc_expand"],"refers":["rustc_proc_macro"],"why":"rustc_expand loads and invokes procedural macros, passing the token-stream API supplied by rustc_proc_macro."},"565":{"about":["rustc_expand"],"refers":["rustc_ast","rustc_proc_macro"],"why":"rustc_expand executes the token-stream transformation and incorporates its result into the AST."},"566":{"about":["rustc_proc_macro","rustc_expand"],"refers":[],"why":"rustc_proc_macro provides the stable procedural-macro token stream, while rustc_expand handles it only at the compiler boundary."}}
